QuestInfo.name: Research on Plant Fossils
QuestInfo.0: Dr. #p308#, a biologist near #m10002000#, is looking for an assistant.
QuestInfo.1: #bDr. #p308##k asked me to help out as her assistant for a bit. My first task is to collect #b8 #t4031072#s#k. I can see a lot of plants covering the woods in #m10002000#.
QuestInfo.2: My first job as Dr. #p308#'s assistant was to collect some plants in the woods in #m10002000# and sample them. It wasn't that hard, I guess.

0.0: You're the one that got me Dr. #p512#'s #t4031071#, right? Good to see you. You didn't forget my plea for help down the road. I've been busily working on the fossils these days. Can you help me out by any chance?

yes.0: Thank you. I've been busily investigating the leaf fossils of a plant, but this is much tougher than I thought. The leaves that are shown on this fossil are very uniquely formed...
yes.1: I need samples to compare against. You'll find various plants all around Ellinia. I need you to gather up a few of those, #b8 #t4031072#s#k to be exact. I'll be waiting for you. Please hurry!
yes.2: The plants that can be used for samples are usually bigger than other plants. They grow in the northern forest of #m10002000#. You'll be able to find them in no time.

no.0: I thought you were going to help me out. If I have to do this by myself, I'll have to get going now. Please don't bother me. See you around.

item.0: I thought I told you #b8 #t4031072#s#k. Did you completely forget about it?
